content.text: The Binding of Isaac Four Souls is a proprietary multiplayer card game where characters fight monsters and collect soul rewards.
The Binding of Isaac Four Souls is documented as a distinct commercial card-game publication with its own player count, equipment, and objective.
2-4 players use the table arrangement described for The Binding of Isaac Four Souls.
Dedicated Four Souls loot, treasure, monster, and character decks
Dedicated Four Souls loot, treasure, monster, and character decks, score area, and enough table space for play.
Prepare Dedicated Four Souls loot, treasure, monster, and character decks and deal or lay out cards according to the documented The Binding of Isaac Four Souls rules before play begins.
